title: Depth-2 bibliography carrier record
description: One Markdown carrier at content/text/documents/articles/bibliographies/<citekey>.md, arguing why a cited work is load-bearing and what it does not settle (2026-08-30 science-topic-section-model specification). Frontmatter carries the depth-1 reference fields plus the carrier's own type/key/reference-type discriminators; additional bibliographic detail fields (journal, volume, number, pages, ...) are permitted and are not part of the closed depth-1 references: map contract.

type.description: Carrier class discriminator; always bibliography for a depth-2 carrier.

key.description: Citekey; must equal the Markdown filename stem.

reference-type.description: BibTeX-like entry kind (article, book, inproceedings, misc, ...).

eprint.description: Preprint identifier, e.g. an arXiv id.

eprinttype.description: Preprint archive naming the eprint id, e.g. arxiv.

publication.description: Journal, conference, or other publication venue.

translator.description: Translator of the cited work, when applicable.

body.description: Argument for why the source is load-bearing, what it does not settle, and its bridges to other carriers.
